name: The Spirit Of Man
overview: Scripture reveals that the spirit of man is a divine gift from God, who formed man from the dust and breathed life into him, making him a living soul (Genesis 2:7). This spirit is the source of understanding and insight, inspired by the Almighty (Job 32:8), and serves as a lamp that searches the innermost parts of a person (Proverbs 20:27). At death, the body returns to the earth, but the spirit returns to God who gave it (Ecclesiastes 12:7), emphasizing the intimate connection between God and the human spirit. Moreover, God Himself forms the spirit of man within him (Zechariah 12:1), distinguishing it from a mere lifeless entity, as seen in the contrast between spirit and physical body in Luke 24:39.
